verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 111.8 (-3.3% in a day) and momentum is 41: prices are falling. 84s cost 950, 85s 2,700 and 86s 5,500. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

moves.title: Sell Marcus Rashford 82 after its 23% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 11,750 coins. Now 12,500. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 23.0% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 3 of 6 so far, averaging +2.7% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-05T07:59:00+00:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 87s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 950 (1.14 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,700 (1.29 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,500 (1.34 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,500 (1.36 coins per Item Score point), 88s 9,900 (1.19 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 88s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Suat Serdar and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Suat Serdar 75 Rare -57.4%; Alfon 75 Rare -56.5%; Johan Vásquez 75 Rare -49.4%; Pietro Terracciano 76 Rare -46.9%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
